ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording praised for keeping the full Good Lovin' intact and noting Mickey's indulgent drum solo.
ai_review.review: The reviewer gives a five‑star rating, mainly because the recording preserves an uncut version of "Good Lovin'" instead of chopping it up. They also point out that the drum solo is treated as its own track, highlighting Mickey’s extended playing style. No audio flaws are mentioned, implying a clean and listenable soundboard source.

ai_rating.rationale: Single five‑star review emphasizes both musical (full Good Lovin', notable drum solo) and technical aspects (no chopping), indicating a high‑quality experience despite limited data.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No complaints about clarity or mix; reviewer appreciates that tracks are not edited or chopped, suggesting an intact and clear capture.
